messages:
Iris Tan: Opening a compact PR to merge quota tier examples, add a Rust SDK snippet, and update the Console panel link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/900
Noah Bennett: Love the Rust example — that's new. Please also include a short note about header name fallbacks for older Dedicated proxies (x-old-quota -> X-Quota-Tier).
Iris Tan: Will add a tiny mapping table and a one-liner migration tip. Draft Rust snippet to read quota tier and burst credits:
```rust
let tier = resp.headers().get("X-Quota-Tier").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("unknown");
let credits: i32 = resp.headers().get("X-Burst-Credits").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()).and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
if credits < 5 { route_to("gpt-economy"); }
```
Yara Singh: For the Console, panel id changed; include both links and mark the old as deprecated. Also add alt text updates for the new screenshots and a one-line QA checklist.
Iris Tan: QA checklist on the PR: verify header names with eng-runtime, replace screenshots, confirm Rust snippet compiles, add changelog entry `docs: quota & billing snippets (rust)`, tag i18n for panel label.
DocsBot: PR 900 opened by Iris Tan — CI: docs-build (staging) passed ✅ — Preview: https://deploy-preview-900--docs.redwood.ai
Noah Bennett: Tiny nit: show a very short cost calc example in Rust too, e.g., compute estimated cost per 1k tokens and print with 4 decimal places.
Iris Tan: Added cost calc example and a short troubleshooting note: if `X-Usage-Cost` header missing, compute client-side using published model rates. Target merge Fri. I'll announce in #announcements once merged. 🚀
